test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 30 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46dc3642ff9f8dddb21abb14757febd0b9764611d9d75710c72bdd23b2aeb3f0.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The 2nd and 3rd element of the 2nd row from the left interchange positions.

The rest of the elements shift clockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/899d1dacfb5f3cb947a62e424c8cc12aba55fa5504594a207762d5b05d706536.png] 

2) Second box series →

The 2nd row elements shift anticlockwise subsequently.

The rest of the elements interchange positions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/832e5052726e38edfe5df9c36653d6d163e9640fd3676ec8966971e6c461a5d7.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8848b5e4dce06721dd11733ff3372a7f558c8653a9552be014d1c1ffbc5260c.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
